dedupe_keys.name: the impact of cyclone ivor on coral reefs of the northern great barrier reef 1990

description: The impact of Cyclone Ivor on coral reefs of the northern Great Barrier Reef (1990) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. In July 1990, surveys were conducted at 46 sites, covering a 300 km section of the northern Great Barrier Reef, located to the north and south of the track of Cyclone Ivor, which passed through the region in March 1990. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. It offers 8 resource(s) in audio/basic, html, kml, png. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
